result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), covering bathhouse, fertilizer plant, pool hall and pet shop health regulations, with no residential rental rules.
result.notes: Although the source URL and page title refer to a San Diego ordinance on algorithmic rent price fixing (Division 11, 98.1103), this part of the document contains only unrelated Chapter 4 health-regulation text (bathhouses, reduction works, pool halls, pet shops). No rule in any of the six rental-housing categories appears in this part, so the list is empty.
